scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Paul Tol-inspired palette (#4477AA / #EE6677 / #228833), generous cell padding, and functioning diagonal KDE update on brush lift the design well above generic, though the bottom-only legend placement is cramped and the row labels overlap the left margin slightly.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Data-driven domains via d3.extent, correct zero-baseline on KDE density areas, Silverman's-rule bandwidth, and fixed-radius scatter dots avoid lie factor; minor gap is absent key function in data joins (no re-render, so no visible corruption).
scores.stress_test_note: The brush handler fires O(cells × data) DOM mutations (2400 circle attr writes) plus KDE recomputation for all diagonal cells on every mousemove with no debouncing, throttling, or requestAnimationFrame coalescing; the dispatch source parameter is threaded through but never checked in the listener to guard against feedback, though no actual loop exists due to the one-directional update path.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Well-executed SPLOM: 3-category palette separates cleanly, 150px cells are readable, KDE diagonal breaks up the grid, and the 16 cells read as one conceptual unit rather than independent views — the only friction is moderate overplotting where versicolor and virginica overlap in petal dimensions, which opacity partially mitigates but doesn't fully resolve.
